en: The Great Vaipulya Mahāmegha Sūtra, Chapter Sixty-Four: The Chapter on Invoking Rain,
translated by the Indian Tripiṭaka Master Jñānayaśas during the Zhou dynasty of the Yuwen clan.
Thus have I heard.
At one time the Buddha was in the palace of the nāga kings Nanda and Upananda, atop a celestial carriage of great majestic power consisting of clouds of mani-jewel treasuries.
Together with a great assembly of bhikṣus and bodhisattva-mahāsattvas,
there were also great nāga kings,
namely the nāga king Nanda and the nāga king Upananda.
The Naga King Sagara, the Naga King Anavatapta,
the Naga King Manasvin, the Naga King Varuna,
the Naga King Takshaka, and the Naga King Dhṛtarāṣṭra.
The Naga King Vasuki, the Naga King Mucilinda,
the Naga King Elapatra, the Naga King Pundarika,
the Naga King Tejorashmi, and the Naga King Sutejas.
The Dragon King Electric Crown, the Dragon King Great Maṇi Jewel Topknot,
the Dragon King Maṇi Jewel Topknot, the Dragon King Radiant Summit,
the Dragon King Śakra-Peak Staff, and the Dragon King Śakra-Banner.
Śakra, relying upon the Dragon King Jambūdhvaja,
the Dragon King Sāgara, the Dragon King Mahācakra,
the Dragon King Mahoraga, and the Dragon King Tejorasa.
The Naga King Candravat, the Naga King Prajñātejas,
the Naga King Sudarśana, the Naga King Sudṛśa,
the Naga King Susthita, and the Naga King Maṇihāra.
The Nāga King Cloud-Ariser, the Nāga King Rain-Bearer,
the Nāga King Great Roar, the Nāga King Minor Roar,
the Nāga King Swift-Pace, and the Nāga King Great-Crest.
The Dragon King Deep Sound,
the Dragon King Great Sound,
the Dragon King Great Heroic Valor, and the Dragon King Utpala.
The Naga King Mahāpāda, the Naga King Śaṅkhakeśa,
the Naga King Citraraṣi, the Naga King Mahāpāśadhara,
the Naga King Elapatra, and the Naga King Pūrvabhāṣin.
The Naga King Assakarṇa, the Naga King Śaṅkha,
the Naga King Dhatara, the Naga King Upadhatara,
the Naga King Saṃvarta, and the Naga King Saṃtuṣita.
The great poisonous snake dragon king, the great poisonous snake dragon king,
the great powerful dragon king, the Hūli dragon king,
the Apalāla dragon king, and the Yamabuddha dragon king.
The Nāga King Kalmāṣapāda, the Nāga King Kāla,
the Nāga King Indrasena, the Nāga King Nata,
the Nāga King Upanata, and the Nāga King Kanakapila.
The Dragon King Dāpita, the Dragon King Prāsādika,
the Dragon King Hastakarṇa, the Dragon King Tīkṣṇa,
the Dragon King Piṅgalākṣa, and the Dragon King Vidyutprabha.
The Naga King Great Lightning Flash, the Naga King Celestial Power,
the Naga King Golden Brahma, the Naga King Wondrous Canopy,
the Naga King Ambrosia, and the Naga King Spring of Attaining the Path.
The Dragon King Vaidūryaprabha, the Dragon King Suvarṇakeśa,
the Dragon King Suvarṇaprabha, the Dragon King Candravyūha,
the Dragon King Sūryaprabha, and the Dragon King Ārambhaka.
The Nandopananda Dragon King addressed the Śvetaketu Dragon King,
the Kṛṣṇaketu Dragon King, the Yama Dragon King,
the Śrāmaṇera Dragon King, and the Maṇicūḍa Dragon King.
The nāga king Saṃghāṭa, the nāga king Nimiṃdhara,
the nāga king Dharaṇīdhara, the thousand-headed nāga king,
the nāga king Maṇicūḍa, and the nāga king Pūrṇamanas.
The Dragon King Sūkṣmavarṣa, the Dragon King Sumeruṇa,
the Dragon King Kumbhīra, the Dragon King Āryaguṇa,
the Dragon King Sucarita, and the Dragon King Pūrvaguṇa.
The King of the Crocodile-Dragons, the King of the Dragon with a Crocodile Head,
the King of the Poisonous Dragons, the King of the Snake-Bodied Dragons,
the Lotus Dragon King, and the Great-Tailed Dragon King.
The Dragon King Utpalaka, the Dragon King Bhīṣma,
the Dragon King Suprabha, the Five-Headed Dragon King,
the Dragon King Parilā, and the Dragon King Citravimāna.
The Naga King Udraka, the Naga King Long-tail,
the Naga King Great-head, the Naga King Bimbika,
the Naga King Ugly-appearance, and the Naga King Horse-shape.
The Dragon King Three-Headed, the Dragon King Dragon-Sage,
the Dragon King Great-Majesty, the Dragon King Fire-Virtue,
the Dragon King Terrifying-People, and the Dragon King Blazing-Light.
The Seven-headed Dragon King, the Manifesting Great Body Dragon King,
the Loving Manifestation Dragon King, the Greatly Malevolent Dragon King,
the Pure Majesty Dragon King, and the Wondrous Eye Dragon King.
The great poisonous dragon king, the dragon king Fiery Shoulder,
the dragon king Fire Harm, the dragon king Swift Virtue,
the dragon king Jewel Cloud, and the dragon king Great Cloud.
The Dragon King Śakraprabha, the Dragon King Padmapa,
the Dragon King Candramegha, the Dragon King Samudramegha,
the Dragon King Mahāgandhapuṣpa, and the Dragon King Puṣpasaṃbhava.
The Dragon King Red-Eyed, the Dragon King Great Banner of Mutual Appearance,
the Dragon King Great Cloud Treasury, the Dragon King Snowfall,
the Dragon King Majestic Virtue Treasury, and the Dragon King Cloud Spear.
The Dragon King Holder-of-Night, the Dragon King Rain-Producer,
the Dragon King Cloud-Rain, the Dragon King Great-Rain,
the Dragon King Fire-Light, and the Dragon King Cloud-King.
The Dragon King Aśaṅga, the Dragon King Kukūpa,
the Dragon King Nāgaśūra, the Dragon King Śalendra,
the Dragon King Meghahasta, and the Dragon King Āṭavika.
The Dragon King Majestic Virtue, the Dragon King Cloud-Born,
the Dragon King Inexhaustible Steps, the Dragon King Wondrous Appearance,
the Dragon King Great Body, and the Dragon King Great Belly.
The Naga King Anshen, the Naga King Zhangfu,
the Naga King Gegena, the Naga King Youtuo,
the Naga King Mengdu, and the Naga King Miaosheng.
The Dragon King Amṛtadṛḍha, the Dragon King Mahāvarṣaka,
the Dragon King Śarkarārava, the Dragon King Stanayitnu-saṃghaṭṭana-śabda,
the Dragon King Dundubhi-svara-nirghoṣa, and the Dragon King Amṛtavarṣin.
The Dragon King Drum of the Heavenly Lord, the Dragon King Thunderous Sound,
the Dragon King Śūrasena, the Dragon King Nārāyaṇa,
the Dragon King Dried-up Waters, and the Dragon King Vikaca.
With all such great nāga kings as these at their head,
there were further eighty-four thousand times ten million billion nayutas of nāgas who all came to the assembly and sat down.
Then all those dragon kings rose from their seats,
adjusted their robes, knelt with their right knees on the ground,
and joined their palms toward the Buddha.
With immeasurable, boundless, and incalculable varieties of exquisite flowers,
fragrances, unguents, powdered incense, flower crowns, garments, precious banners,
flags, canopies, dragon-flowers, jeweled strings, pearl necklaces, precious blossoms, and silken fabrics.
A net of pearls covered the Tathāgata from above;
they performed various musical entertainments, clapped their hands, and sang praises,
giving rise to a heart of profound reverence and extraordinary wonder.
Having circumambulated them hundreds of thousands of times, they withdrew to stand to one side.
Standing there, they all made this vow:
"May [all beings] attain oceans of bodies as numerous as the atoms within the oceans of all worlds."
The ocean-like assemblies of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas transcend all oceans of worlds,
having already passed beyond all atoms of earth, water, fire, and wind.
All the oceans of atoms of the radiance of form,
which have already transcended immeasurable, inconceivable, incomparable, and unspeakable numbers of *asaṃkhyeya* oceans of bodies.
Within each and every body,
he emanates immeasurable, incalculable oceans of clouds of hands,
which pervade every single atom throughout the ten directions as oceans of clouds of all manner of offerings.
Pervading the ten directions, they make offerings to the ocean-like assemblies of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas,
never ceasing for an instant.
Such are the immeasurable, inconceivable, incomparable, and ineffable *asaṃkhyeya* clouds of oceans of bodies of Samantabhadra’s practices.
Pervading all of space, they abide and persist without interruption,
like clouds of oceans of bodhisattva bodies and clouds of oceans of all wheel-marks.
Ocean-clouds of all jeweled crowns;
ocean-clouds of all great luminous jewel-treasury carriages;
ocean-clouds of all powdered-incense-tree treasuries.
Clouds of oceans of all fragrant incense smoke manifesting various colors;
clouds of oceans of the sounds of all musical instruments;
clouds of oceans of all fragrant trees.
In this way, immeasurable, inconceivable, incomparable, and innumerable,
unspeakably many *asaṃkhyeya* oceans of all offerings,
like clouds, pervaded the entirety of space, remaining and persisting without interruption.

Making offerings to, honoring, respecting, and serving the ocean-like assemblies of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas with clouds of oceans of mani-jewel kings from the lightning-light treasury of all adorned realms.
Pervading all of space and remaining without interruption,
they made offerings, paid homage, showed respect, and served oceans of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas with clouds of oceans of mani-jewel kings adorned by universal radiant rains of jewels.
Clouds of oceans of mani jewel kings with the radiance of all precious flames that accord with the Buddha’s voice;
clouds of oceans of mani jewel kings with the sounds of all Buddha-dharma pervading everywhere.
Ocean-clouds of emanated Buddhas from the jewels of universal gate-light;
ocean-clouds of mani-jewel kings manifesting ceaseless arrays of all manner of lights.
Cloud-oceans of mani-jewel kings with rays of light that accord with the holy conduct of all Buddhas;
cloud-oceans of mani-jewel kings with the light of the inconceivable Buddha-land palaces manifested by all Tathāgatas.
There were clouds of oceans of maṇi jewels from the bodies of all Buddhas of the three periods of time,
with the colors and brilliance of every kind of exquisite jewel; such jewel-lights and colors filled the entirety of space,
remaining and sustaining themselves without interruption.
Offerings and services rendered with reverence, respect, and honor to the ocean-like assemblies of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas:
oceans of clouds of indestructible, wondrous jewel incense and flower chariots;
oceans of clouds of chariots adorned with infinite-colored mani-jewel kings.
Ocean-clouds of all kinds of precious lamp-flame incense chariots;
ocean-clouds of all kinds of pearl-colored exquisite chariots;
ocean-clouds of all kinds of flower-pedestal chariots.
Ocean-like clouds of palanquins adorned with all manner of jeweled crowns;
ocean-like clouds of treasure-palanquins adorned with uninterrupted arrays of light-flames filling all ten directions;
ocean-like clouds of palanquins adorned with infinitely manifesting supreme jewels.
Ocean-clouds of magnificent, universally pervasive, and wondrously adorned palanquins;
ocean-clouds of palanquins with lattices of flower-bells on all their gates and railings;
such as these filled the void, remaining and sustaining themselves without interruption.

Making offerings, paying homage, respecting, and serving the ocean-like assemblies of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas with oceans of lion thrones from the treasury of exquisite golden jewel necklaces, like clouds.
Oceans of clouds of lion thrones, which are treasuries of the wondrous colors of all radiant flowers;
oceans of clouds of lion thrones, which are treasuries of lotuses of wondrous color made of dark-blue maṇi-jewels and Jāmbūnada gold.
Ocean-clouds of lion thrones of the lotus-treasury of all mani-lamps;
ocean-clouds of lion thrones of the treasury of wonderful flowers of fire-colored hue from all mani-jewel banners.
Ocean-clouds of lion thrones from the lotus treasury of exquisite colors adorned with all kinds of jewels;
ocean-clouds of lion thrones from the light-treasury of Indra-lotuses that are delightful for all to behold.
The ocean-clouds of lion-throne lotus-treasuries with the inexhaustible radiance of being seen by all as delightful;
the ocean-clouds of lion-throne lotus-treasuries universally illumined by the light of all jewels.
The ocean-clouds of lion thrones, which are treasuries of lotus-light and the voices of all Buddhas—
such as these, filling the entirety of space, remained steadfast and uninterrupted,
making offerings, paying homage, honoring, and serving the ocean-like assemblies of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.
Furthermore, there emerged ocean-like clouds of all kinds of exquisite fragrant mani-trees;
ocean-like clouds of trees whose leaves join together in reverent salutation on all sides to emit fragrances;
and ocean-like clouds of trees manifesting infinite radiant colors as their adornments.
Cloud-seas of all-flower clouds emerge as cloud-seas of jewel-tree oceans;
all emerge as cloud-seas of trees from the treasury of infinite adornments;
all emerge as cloud-seas of jewel-wheel flaming lightning trees.
Cloud-seas of bodhisattvas manifesting from half their bodies as sandalwood powder trees;
cloud-seas of the adornments of the bodhimanda trees by all inconceivable and boundless tree deities.
There were ocean-like clouds of trees with the radiance of suns from treasuries of all kinds of precious garments,
and ocean-like clouds of trees that universally emit delightful and wondrous sounds and are joyfully beheld;
such as these filled the void, remaining and sustaining themselves without ceasing.
They made offerings of honor, respect, veneration, and service to the ocean-like assemblies of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas,
and further produced ocean-clouds of lion thrones from the matrix of infinite jewel-colored lotuses.
Ocean-clouds of lion thrones from the treasury of all-pervading mani-kings and lightning;
ocean-clouds of lion thrones from the treasury of all-garland ornaments;
ocean-clouds of lion thrones from the treasury of all wonderful jewel crowns and lamp-flames.
Ocean-clouds of lion thrones that are treasuries of precious rain emerging from all perfect sounds;
ocean-clouds of lion thrones that are treasuries of fragrant flowers and all flower crowns;
ocean-clouds of lion thrones that are treasuries of the king of mani-jewels manifesting adornments for all Buddha-seats.
Ocean-clouds of lion thrones from the treasury of all balustrades adorned with hanging garlands;
ocean-clouds of lion thrones from the treasury of the branches, leaves, and powdered incense of all mani-jewel trees.
There were oceans of clouds of lion thrones named Sunlight-Treasury, universally adorned with nets of precious bells of all exquisite fragrances;
such as these filled the entirety of space, remaining and sustaining themselves without ceasing.
They made offerings of honor, respect, reverence, and service to the ocean-like assemblies of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas,
and further produced oceans of clouds of canopies made of all kinds of sovereign wish-fulfilling maṇi jewels.
Ocean-clouds of canopies adorned with all kinds of *indra-ratna* flower pedestals;
ocean-clouds of canopies made of all kinds of fragrant *maṇi* jewels;
ocean-clouds of canopies characterized by the flames of all kinds of jewel lamps.
Ocean-clouds of canopies of mani-jewel kings that emit the voices of all buddhas’ spiritual powers;
ocean-clouds of canopies adorned with the various lights of manifest mani-miraculous robes.
Ocean-clouds of canopies of all jewel-lamps of radiant flower-flames;
ocean-clouds of canopies of all nets of exquisite bells whose sounds pervade everywhere;
ocean-clouds of canopies of all inexhaustible, wondrously colored mani-jewel terraces and lotus-nets.
Ocean-like clouds of canopies of all golden flower-pedestals and flaming jewel-banners;
ocean-like clouds of canopies of all inconceivable arrays of radiant necklaces;
such as these filled the void, remaining and sustaining themselves without ceasing.
They made offerings, paid homage, revered, and served the ocean-like assemblies of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas,
further emitting ocean-clouds of various exquisite mani-jewel canopies.
Ocean-clouds of canopies adorned with all manner of infinite radiant light;
ocean-clouds of canopies from the treasury of pearls of all boundless colors;
ocean-clouds of canopies of mani-jewel kings with the sounds of the gates of compassion of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.
Ocean-clouds of canopies of all exquisite colored jewel-flame flower crowns;
ocean-clouds of canopies of jewel-light-adorned hanging-bell lattices;
ocean-clouds of canopies of *maṇi*-tree-branch necklaces.
Ocean-clouds of all sun-illuminating, translucent flame-maṇi king incense-smoke canopies;
ocean-clouds of all sandalwood-powder treasuries of universally perfuming canopies;
and the lightning flashes of all the ultimate realms of the Buddhas.
Oceans of clouds of canopies, universally adorned with flames;
such as these fill the entirety of space, remaining and sustaining themselves without interruption,
making offerings, paying homage, showing respect, and serving the ocean-like assemblies of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.
Furthermore, there issued forth clouds of oceans of all-jeweled luminous wheels;
clouds of oceans of all-jeweled flame-patterned light-wheel circles;
and clouds of oceans of all-flower-cloud flame-light wheel circles.
Ocean-clouds of jewel-light wheels manifested by all Buddhas;
ocean-clouds of light wheels appearing and entering all Buddha-fields;
ocean-clouds of jewel-branch light wheels with the sounds of universal gates throughout the realms of all Buddhas.
Cloud-oceans of flaming light wheels of all vaidūrya-jewel-nature maṇi-kings;
cloud-oceans of color-form light wheels appearing at the moment of all sentient beings' recollection;
cloud-oceans of great thundering sound light wheels produced by the wondrous vows of all Buddhas.
Cloud-seas of light-orbs from the mani-jewel kings of the voices of all assemblies of transformed beings pervade the entirety of space,
remaining and sustaining themselves without interruption,
as offerings of worship, reverence, respect, and service to the ocean-like assemblies of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.
Furthermore, there emerged clouds of oceans of flames from the treasury of all mani-jewels;
clouds of oceans of flames of all Buddhas' forms, sounds, fragrances, tastes, and textures;
and clouds of oceans of flames of all jewels.
A sea-cloud of the pervasive resonance of all Buddha-dharmas;
a sea-cloud of the lightning-flames of the adornments of all Buddha-fields;
a sea-cloud of flaming flower-litters.
Cloud-oceans of all jewel-light-flame seas;
cloud-oceans of the flames of the sounds of Buddhas appearing throughout all kalpas to transform sentient beings;
cloud-oceans of the flames of all inexhaustible jewel-flower garlands manifesting before all sentient beings.
There were clouds of oceans of flames manifesting the adornments of all thrones;
such as these filled the entirety of space, remaining and supporting themselves without interruption,
as offerings of worship, reverence, respect, and service to the ocean-like assemblies of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.
Furthermore, there issued forth clouds of oceans of light from all infinite colored jewels;
clouds of oceans of universal radiance from all mani-jewel kings;
and clouds of oceans of lightning-light from the adornments of all Buddha-fields.
Cloud-seas of all fragrant lights;
cloud-seas of all adorned lights;
cloud-seas of all Buddhas' transformative lights.
Clouds of oceans of light from the flowers of all various jewel-trees;
clouds of oceans of light from all garments;
clouds of oceans of light from the mani-jewel kings of the sounds of all boundless bodhisattva practices.
Oceans of clouds of light from all kinds of pearls,
and so forth, fill the entirety of space, remaining and persisting without interruption,
as offerings of worship, reverence, respect, and service to the oceans of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.
Furthermore, there issued forth ocean-clouds of all kinds of inconceivable mixed fragrant flowers;
ocean-clouds of jewel-flame lotus flower nets;
and ocean-clouds of light-wheels of all immeasurable colors of mani jewels.
Cloud-seas of the colors of all genuine jewel treasuries;
cloud-seas of powdered sandalwood incense made of all jewels;
and cloud-seas of all precious canopies.
Cloud-oceans of mani-jewel kings of all pure and wondrous sounds;
cloud-oceans of sun-illumining mani-bead necklaces;
cloud-oceans of all boundless treasuries of jewels.
In this manner, all such oceans of clouds of Samantabhadra’s bodies fill the entirety of space,
remaining and persisting without interruption,
making offerings, paying homage, showing respect, and serving the ocean-like assemblies of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.
Then all those dragon kings,
having performed such acts of dedication,
circumambulated the Buddha three times and prostrated themselves at his feet.
Empowered by the Buddha’s majestic spiritual authority,
they each returned to their original seats. At that time,
there was among the assembly a dragon king named Boundless Adornment Ocean-Cloud Majestic Virtue Wheel Canopy.
Among the dragon kings within the trichiliocosm,
he is the most eminent and great; having attained non-retrogression,
he has assumed this dragon body through the power of his original vow.
Desiring to make offerings to, pay homage to, and prostrate before the Tathāgata in order to hear and receive the True Dharma,
he has come here to this Jambudvīpa.
At that time, the Dragon King rose from his seat.
He adjusted his robes, bared his right shoulder,
knelt with his right knee on the ground, joined his palms toward the Buddha,
and spoke these words:
“World-Honored One, I now have a doubt and wish to question the Tathāgata, the Arhat, the Samyaksaṃbuddha.
If the Buddha grants me permission, I shall venture to ask.”
Having spoken these words,
at that time the World-Honored One addressed the Dragon King Anantavyūha-sāgaramegha-tejorājacakravartimaṇḍala, saying:
"O Dragon King, if you have any doubts, feel free to ask whatever you wish;
I shall analyze and explain them for you so that you may be filled with joy.
Having spoken these words, [he remained silent].
Then the Nāga King Anantavyūha-samudra-megha-tejo-rāja-cakravarti-vitāna addressed the Buddha, saying:
"World-Honored One, how can all the nāga kings cause the extinction of all suffering and attain peace and happiness?"
Having experienced peace and happiness,
sweet rain shall fall in due season upon this Jambudvīpa,
causing all trees and forests to grow.
The medicinal herbs and crops all produced their essences,
causing all people throughout Jambudvīpa to experience complete happiness.
Having spoken these words, [he continued:]
At that time, the World-Honored One addressed the Dragon King Anantavyūha-sāgara-megha-tejo-rāja-cchatra, saying:
"Excellent, excellent!
You now act for the benefit of those sentient beings."
That you are able to ask the Tathāgata about such matters as these—
O Dragon King, listen now,
listen attentively, and reflect upon it well.
I shall analyze and explain this for you.
Nāga King, there is a single dharma;
if you are able to fully practice it, [you will attain liberation].
It causes all nāgas to eliminate all suffering and become fully endowed with peace and happiness.
What is this one dharma?
It is the practice of great loving-kindness (mahāmaitrī).
O Dragon King, if there are gods or humans who practice great loving-kindness,
fire cannot burn them, water cannot drown them,
poison cannot harm them, and blades cannot wound them.
Furthermore, enemies and bandits will be unable to plunder him;
whether sleeping or awake, he shall always attain peace and security.
By the power of practicing great loving-kindness, he possesses great majestic virtue.
The gods and the world cannot disturb or afflict them;
their physical appearance is upright and majestic, and they are loved and respected by all;
wherever they go, they encounter no obstacles whatsoever.
All sufferings are extinguished and the mind attains joy because of the power of great compassion that fulfills all forms of happiness.
After the end of life, one will be reborn in the Brahma Heaven, or as a dragon king, or among those gods or humans who practice great compassion.
One obtains such immeasurable benefits as these.
Therefore, O Dragon King, you should always practice that great conduct of loving-kindness through your physical, verbal, and mental actions.
Furthermore, O Dragon King, there is a dhāraṇī.
It is named "Bestower of All Peace and Bliss.
You all must constantly read, recite, receive, and uphold it;
it can extinguish the suffering and afflictions of all nāgas and grant them peace and bliss.
In Jambudvīpa, rain falls in its proper season,
enabling all trees, groves, medicinal herbs,
and crops to produce their essential flavors.
O Dragon King, what is the dhāraṇī that bestows all peace and happiness?
I shall now explain it to you:
*tad yathā | dhāraṇi dhāraṇi udadhāraṇi svabhāviśeṣa-vijaya-varaṇāntiye parāvṛti yaśasvarāha yanavati uttaravardhani*.
Vināhanī abhisyaye cāni abhiviyāharo.
Śubhavatī-acintya-vibhāga-bhāṣita-guhya-kṛtsna-śāstra.
Tunābābāśudhaye Mallekaniḷiha.
Gadāmadhusūdana gadāvidhimalārajaśatrukaśamana.
Sarvabuddhaparigrahādiśaktiṃ dhiprajñāna vi svāhā.
O Dragon King, this is the dhāraṇī for bestowing all peace and happiness.
You all must receive, uphold, read, and recite that which is maintained by all Buddhas;
thus you shall achieve auspicious success, enter the Dharma-gate, and obtain peaceful bliss.
Furthermore, O Dragon Kings, there is the Great Cloud-born Wheel of Majestic Power and Adornment, the Merit and Wisdom Mark, the Water-Treasury, which transforms into golden light.
From a single pore of Vairocana,
the names of all Tathāgatas of the same nature emerge;
you all must likewise recollect and uphold the names of those Tathāgatas.
It can extinguish all the various natures of the dragon lineages,
as well as all the suffering and affliction experienced by the dragon kings, their retinues and followers, and all the female dragons born in the dragon palaces.
For the sake of peace and happiness, O Dragon King, you should thus invoke the names of all those Tathāgatas:
Homage to the Tathāgata Vairocanagarbha-mahāmegha; Homage to the Tathāgata Svabhāvaprabhava-megha.
Homage to the Tathāgata Vṛṣṭimegha. Homage to the Tathāgata Tejomegha.
Homage to the Tathāgata Mahābhyudgamamegha. Homage to the Tathāgata Mahāvātavidhamanamegha.
Homage to the Tathāgata Mahāvidyutpradīpamegha. Homage to the Tathāgata Mahāvikrāntagatimegha.
Homage to the Tathāgata Supuṇya-megha. Homage to the Tathāgata Mahā-guhya-megha.
Homage to the Tathāgata Mahā-megha-cakra. Homage to the Tathāgata Prabhā-megha. Homage to the Tathāgata Mahā-siṃhāsana-megha. Homage to the Tathāgata Mahā-cchatra-megha.

Homage to the Tathāgata Mahā-sudarśana-megha. Homage to the Tathāgata Āvaraṇa-megha. Homage to the Tathāgata Raśmi-maṇḍala-samanta-daśadig-vidyut-tūrya-nirghoṣa-megha-saṃbhava. Homage to the Tathāgata Mahā-śīta-granthi-yuddha-stambhana-gambhīra-ghoṣa-megha. Homage to the Tathāgata Megha-vyūha.
